map.输入静电初始电压、衰减后电压与衰减时间，计算织物静电半衰期并对照标准判定抗静电性: Enter the initial static voltage, the decayed voltage and the decay time to compute the fabric static half-life and grade antistatic performance against the standard, for quality inspection of textile antistatic finishing.
map.测织物静电压衰减到一半的时间，评抗静电等级: Measure the time for fabric static voltage to decay by half and grade antistatic performance
map.防静电服面料选型时对比半衰期: Compare half-life when selecting antistatic workwear fabric

map.：初始电压 5000 V、衰减到 500 V 用 5 s → 半衰期 t₁/₂: : initial voltage 5000 V decaying to 500 V in 5 s -> half-life t1/2 = 5 × ln2 / ln(5000/500) = 5 × 0.693 / 1 ≈ 3.46 s; below 2 s is excellent.
map.：半衰期 < 2 s 抗静电优（适洁净/防爆服）；2–10 s 良；>10 s: : a half-life below 2 s means excellent antistatic performance (suits cleanroom or explosion-proof clothing); 2-10 s is good; above 10 s accumulates static easily and needs conductive threads.
map.给试样加高压达初始电压，断开后记录衰减到一半所用时间，按 GB/T 12703: Charge the specimen to the initial voltage at high pressure, disconnect, record the time to decay to half, per the GB/T 12703 method.
